balls.text: swings his bat hard, misses and they are able to run a bye to end on 120/7 in 20 overs
outside edge and Gilly has taken his fourth catch! Slanting into the batsman, gave himself room, went for a heave, outside edge through to the wicket-keeper, ending a superb knock of 48 from Bravo
short ball to the new batsman, went for the pull, gets a bit of an inside edge to the left of short fine-leg
short ball yet again, he was lining up to swat it away yet again and in the end, needed to fend it off to the off side
pitched up and lofted by Bravo, goes high yet again, the mid-on fielder runs back and does not get to the ball, the long-off comes around and stops it
on the leg stump, gives himself room and still tries to lift it straight over the bowler, went to long-on and they are able to run back for the second
short of length, pushed away to the leg side and off for a quick single, end of a decent spell from Mahmood
short ball and that has been pulled away to the long-on fielder! He was trying to swat it over the boundary but PK comes around and takes the catch rather casually, just a yard from the fence
room given yet again, short of length, wanted to cut it away through the off side where there weren't too many fielders, but misses
short arm tee, and it lands over long-on for a six! It was pitched up, not too quicker, he did not give it his all and yet managed to get it over the fielder for a maximum
short ball, quicker as well and pulled away to the right of deep square-leg for a four! Some momentum, can we hope?
short of length, extra bounce and that hits Bravo on his gloves, still they are able to get away for a single
outside the off stump, short as well and pushed to the off side for a single
on his pads and he is on his toes, flicks it away to the fine-leg for a four!
wants to swing it away, over the extra-cover, it was short too but too quick for the batsman and moving away as well, misses
edged and almost carries to the point, short of the length, wanted to jab it away to the leg side, gets an outside edge for a single
short of length yet again, outside the off stump, pushed to the off side and they are off for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, pushed to the off side, the point fielder went to hit the stumps, overthrow gets him a single
round the stumps, tries to flick it away, misses, hits his pads and a frustrated Bravo tries to hit the ground in disgust at missing out on it, almost takes the wicket-keeper's head there!
shorter outside the off stump, spinning away, played away to long-on
shorter, round the wicket, pushed quicker too, punched to the off side for a single
six more from Bravo, pitched right up to the bat and he swings over mid-wicket this time for a six!
quicker from Hussey but very short and Bravo has slapped it back over the bowler's head for a six!
outside the off stump, slower one, 92 km/hr, pushed to the off side
outside the off stump, still moving away from the batsman and Bravo goes for a swish, misses completely yet again, only one from that over!
outside the off stump, not so short but Bravo is still on the front foot and punches it to the covers
goes for a hoick and that is a top-edge easily taken by the point fielder, was a short ball, went for the pull and does not get anywhere near the middle of the bat, simple catch.
on the leg side, pitched slightly up to the bat, nudged to fine-leg for a single
Whoa, went for a huge one, inside out over the extra-cover and missed it by miles! Short and outside the off stump
short ball, Bravo's on the back foot yet again, jumps up while playing that push to the right of the fielder
pitched right up to the bat, 96.3 km/hr, defended back to the bowler
short ball on his pads, flicked away to the square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, driven to point and they take a single, stumps have been disturbed by the keeper and the third-umpire called for the run-out appeal, not-out.
pitched up, goes down to the track, drives to long-on for a single
shorter from Hussey, played away to the off side, they get an easy single and Awana makes a hash of it, to allow the batsman to come back for the second
pitched up to the batsman, on the middle stump, he turns it away to mid-wicket for a single
pitched right up to the bat, on his pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
short of length, a bit of bounce for Chawla, defended on the back foot, to short third-man
outside the off stump, bowled from wide of the crease, quicker too, beats the outside edge of the cut
slows it down, he comes on to the front foot, defends it back to the bowler
drilled through the covers for a four this time, it was outside the off stump, pitched slightly up, Bravo goes on to his front foot and drives through the covers
a very short ball from Chawla and that has been picked up well and deposited into the mid-wicket fence for a six. What a poor start!
on the middle stump, flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
slower this time, on his pads, tapped away to the leg side for a single
quicker one and outside the off stump, left alone
short of the length, and the ball grips and turns away from the left-hander, beats him
slower this time, on the front foot, defended back to the bowler, who fields on his left
quicker one, drifting down, hits the pads and a stifled appeal
on his pads and that is almost nonchalantly flicked away to the leg side for a couple of runs, the deep square-leg had to run to the right to clean it up
outside the off stump, punches to the off side and again, there is no run for Bravo
another one short of the length, Jadeja goes on to the back foot and defends on the off side, runs away for a single
short ball, outside the off stump and allows it to go through to the wicket-keeper
width this time and he has been spanked away through point to the third-man for a four!
pitched right up on return, bit of swing, and driven back for a four, long time coming that!
on the back foot, jumps up and punched back to the bowler
short of length outside the off stump and Bravo punches it to the right of point, where it is fielded and the scoreboard refrains from ticking over
short of length, punched back by the batsman, who is on the back foot, but to the bowler
on the off stump and seams away after pitching, beats Bravo on the back foot, through to the keeper

edged and gone, caught at third-man! Dhoni was attempting this stroke throughout his innings, this time he finally got some bat on it and the outside edge carries to the third-man fielder easily, four down on a seaming wicket with not too many on the board.
outside the off stump, goes on to the back foot and stylishly punches it to the deep cover for a single
outside the off stump and Dhoni wants to play the cut shot, but misses the outside edge
short of length ball, goes on to the back foot and fends it off to the on-side, single for Bravo
short one attempted, goes on the back foot and ducks under it, well bowled again, four dots in a row
length ball outside the off and for the third time he lets it go, this is excellent stuff from Mahmood
outside the off off stump, pitched up to the batsman, Bravo gets his foot out but shoulders arms at the last moment
short of length and the batsman is on the back foot, defends it back to the bowler
short of length again and this time Dhoni shoulders arms
on the off stump, short of length, on the back foot and nips away from the batsman, misses the bat by a whisker, nearly a fourth catch for Gilly
outside the off stump, pitched up to the bat and Dhoni lets that one go through to the wicket-keeper, 138.4 km/hr
outside the off stump and tries to slash it away, gets an outside edge and it falls short of the third-man, fields on the bounce.
outside the off stump, goes for a bit of a drive, an inside edge and he is through for a quick single
on the length, Dhoni's on his back foot, defended back, 137.2 km/hr
pitched up to the batsman, and Bravo is on the back foot to that one, tries to swish at it and misses it.
on the back foot, length ball, defended away on the back foot to the covers
edged and caught behind! Pitched up and Raina was going for the drive, gets a thick outside edge and it it through to the keeper, easily caught this time and Chennai are in trouble here
goes for another expansive pull to a length ball, gets the bottom of the bat and it trickles away to fine-leg where they get a couple
six more, and this is off an edge, a bouncer in retaliation to the previous six, gets a top edge and it carries to the fine fine-leg region for another maximum!
half volley, opens his feet up and swings it over long-off for a six! Almost came out of nowhere
on the leg stump and Raina did not have much clue about which way it was going to swing, hits his pads and Dhoni calls him through for a leg-bye
on the middle stump, on a length, Dhoni flicks it away to deep square-leg for a single
length ball, on the back foot, pushed to the leg side and he continues to get nothing
short of length, punched to the off side, the keeper is up to the stumps now
shimmies down the track, pushed to the covers and to the fielder
edged and dropped! Regulation catch at the first slip, and the edge is put down by Chawla! It was moving away from the bat, he got a bit of bat there.
outside the off stump again and this time Dhoni shoulders arms, only one off that over
short of length, Dhoni is on his back foot and it beats him on the out-swing.
outside the off stump, short of length and Raina was waiting for it on his back foot, goes for a cut, and it goes on the bounce to PK at third-man
on the back foot to a ball short of length, pushes back to the right of the bowler
outside the off stump, bit of angle away from the bat, zip as well and beats the outside edge of the bat
outside the off stump, short of length, punched to the covers and goes to the fielder at short cover
and no, this time he stays back, on the back foot, defended to the covers
and this is a strange, strange shot again, there was a third slip called up, Dhoni goes down the track again and gets a thick outside edge over the third slip for four!
and he goes down the track as well, short of length, moves away from the batsman and is beaten!
down the track, was getting frustrated by the constant prodding and poking, this time he does not miss the outside edge and Gilchrist does the rest behind the wickets!
on his pads, nudged away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single, to move off the mark
outside edge, but falls away from the two slips, to third-man for a single, it was pitched up, moving away from the batsman
pitched up to Raina this time, on the middle and it is pushed to mid-on, only one from that over
outside the off stump, length ball, shoulders arms and allows it to go through
on the middle stump, tapped to the leg side for a single
another one outside the off, beaten again! This one did not swing too much, but Hussey was caught in the crease, missed it again
outside the off stump and lot of bounce, pegged him on the back foot and Hussey was beaten, to the wicket-keeper
outside the off stump, pitched up and driven to the covers, straight to the fielder, it was travelling too

gone, edged and caught behind! This was the second time he attempted that expansive stroke to a ball he thought was pitched up, this time he gets an outside edge and Gilchrist, on his return to the team, takes a simple catch
on the leg stump, hint of deviation away from the batsman and he has tapped it away to the leg side for a single
on his pads, good length, nudged away to the on-side for a single, deep square-leg comes up to field that one
on the middle stump, length ball, defended back to the bowler
shot and timing! The previous one, he was trying to smack it, this time, he caresses it through extra-cover for four!
outside the off stump, on the length and Vijay was going for it, misses it by a margin
similar delivery as the last one, except that this one does not do as much as the previous one and Hussey lets it go again
outside the off stump, swinging away from the left-handed Hussey and the umpire's called that a wide. Very surprising call, it was well inside the line
on his pads, pitched up by the bowler, flicked it to fine-leg and on the bounce, it goes quickly to PK
Oooh! On the off stump and short of length, on the back foot, swinging away and beats the outside edge of the bat
length ball outside the off stump, leaving it alone and it bounces a lot too, through to the keeper
quick single taken by the batsmen, in-swinger, hits the pads and it drops close to the crease, Vijay calls and runs for the quick single
outside the off stump, pitched up and Hussey just pushes it through wide mid-off for four! He was just leaning into the push and it sped away
outside the off stump again, deviation continues but it too far away from the batsman to bother him and he lets that go through to the keeper.
pitched fuller this time, on the back foot, punched into the covers to the fielder. Still some of the swing...
outside the off stump, length ball, moving away from the batsman, left alone by Vijay
outside the off stump, short of length, slashed away by Vijay and misfield by Awana at third-man, running to the right!
on the off stump and this time it is moving away, couple of slips in place but defended on the back foot to the covers
outside the off stump but darting back into the batsman, defended back to the bowler.
short ball and that is pulled away to square-leg for a four, game, set and match Punjab
swings at the length ball and misses it, short of length yet again
short of length, nipping away from the seam, beats the outside edge of the bat and the bowler appealed for a catch-behind, Dhoni did not
on the back foot, was trying to cut it through the covers, does not get it in the middle of the bat and it has gone to short cover
shorter and quicker from Hilfenhaus, Mahmood manages to pull it away to deep square-leg for a single.
pitched up this time and swinging away from the batsman, goes for a big one, misses the outside edge, through to the keeper
goes for a pull again, but this time Hilfenhaus is too quick for him, the top edge is beaten
outside the off stump and that has been flashed away over point for a four
edged and gone! Outside the off stump, goes for a big heave over the off side, manages only the outside edge and that is easily caught by the wicket-keeper
smashed over backward square-leg for a six! That was a quicker one angling in and Gilchrist has picked it up and slammed it into the fence for a biggie, 22 from that Mahesh over
bludgeoned, pitched up and that has been deposited over mid-off for a four, Gilchrist's playing his first game since recovering from tearing both his hamstrings.
slower one, on a good length, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single
pitched on the length this time, Gilly is on his back foot, pushed to mid-wicket for a single
short again and the tactic is clearly not working, it has been pulled over the deep square-leg region for a six to take him to his half-century
the short ball stuff continues and this was drifting down the leg side, Gilly pulls him over fine-leg, almost helping it on its way for a four
over mid-off and that's four, pitched up after the barrage of short stuff and Chitniss looked to be almost waiting for it, slashes it over mid-off
short ball and he ducks under that one, looked wide to me
short one yet again, this time on the leg side and he goes for the pull, does not come off the middle of the bat and goes to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, punched to the left of the short cover for a single
short ball, but this time on the stumps and he has lofted it over the in-field, the deep square-leg fielder comes in but is way short
outside the off stump and Gilly cuts it away over point for a four! Short and wide it was, Bravo has got a couple of wickets but this time it has been dispatched

up and over and almost gone for four, the fielder from third-man runs to his right, dives and stops it from going for a four, but in the process he is down, seems to have done his shoulder badly has Anirudha, probably a dislocation
shorter ball from Mahesh, Gilly unleashes his favourite pull, but goes to the fine-leg fielder for a single
shorter length yet again and he is on the back foot, flicks it away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
on the stumps, but shorter, on the back foot and defended to the point fielder
outside the off stump and cut it away to the covers for a single
short of length from Mahesh and Gilchrist is on the back foot, defends it back to the bowler
pitched right up the batsman, Gilly drives to long-off for a single
on the off stump, pitched further up too, he is on the back foot, opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single
half a jab, half a pull to that one which was pitched shorter from Morkel, ticks over to 34 and Punjab now need 47
shorter from Morkel, goes for a pull, misses, hits the pads and there was an appeal, too high though
late cut it away to the deep third-man for a couple, it was just outside the off and he opened the face of the bat, cut to Hilfenhaus
on the off stump, short of length, defended on the off side to the covers
bouncer and Chitnis ducks under the ball, end of a wicket-taking over.
outside the off stump, pitched on the length, defended back to the bowler
short of length, on the middle stump, pushed away to the leg side for a single
shorter from Bravo, tapped away to the backward square-leg region for a single
edged and caught, Hussey has been caught behind! This was wider as well, there was bounce on that one and that takes the top-edge through to the keeper, three down now!
outside the off stump and this has been cut away, after missing all those cuts last over from Bravo, he gets his bat on this and it has sped away!
on the back foot, quicker, and he was trying to work it away to the leg side, misses it and there is a huge appeal for an lbw, but it seemed to be going down
pitched up and Gilly has swept him away for four to fine-leg, the required-rate comes down yet again
shorter ball, cut away to the deep point for a single
quicker, on his pads and that is flicked away, misses, hits the pads and they are away for a single
outside the off stump, Hussey goes for a drive, gets the outside half of the bat and it loops up to the sweeper fielder, but on the bounce
shorter this time, tapped away to the leg side for a single, the bowler misses the return throw and they come back for the second
outside the off stump, wide yet again, this time he is able to tap it away to the sweeper for a single
on his pads, flicks it away but it is so fine that Dhoni can get around to it
pitched right up, was going for a drive, misses the outside edge of the bat through to the keeper
slower and outside the off stump, wanted to go for the cut, gets the toe end of the bat, to short cover
outside the off stump, wanted to go for the cut, it was swinging away slightly and gets only a top edge, through to the keeper and Punjab have lost their second now!
fullish ball, outside the off stump, pushed to the off side
pitched up, outside the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
angling into the batsman, knocks it away to the deep mid-wicket for a single
angling into the batsman, defended back to the bowler
outside the off stump, length ball, left alone
angling in, round the wicket, defended back to the bowler
short outside the off stump, cut away, bit of a misfeld by Hilfenhaus and they come back for the second
slower one, shorter too and that is defended back to the bowler
swings it and is bowled! Length ball, wanted to swing it over mid-wicket but misses it, ball hits the top of the stumps and the bails are on the ground
short again, angling into the batsman, inside edge and it bounces just in front of the bat, Gilly does not want the run
deliberate edge over the slips for a four, quicker, short of length and the top edge has raced away for a four
shot, what a shot! It was played on the up and it was done with so much power that even a fielder was present at long-off it would have beaten him, there was no fielder and it has gone to the fence!
on the middle stump, pitched right up to the bat and he goes for a big hit, misses and it yorks him, misses the stumps too
swept away and it bounces once before rolling over the boundary for a four, nine off the over
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and to point
quicker, pushed through as well, pushed to the point fielder
slower from Ashwin, he was going for an expansive one before checking the stroke
short ball from Ashwin, that allowed Gilly enough time to rock back and pull it away, over the umpire at square-leg for a four
down the track and drilled through straight, goes to long-on for a single
short of length, outside the off stump, punched to the point fielder and that gives them no run
pitched up this time, goes for a swing over mid-wicket, misses through to the keeper
bouncer, outside the off stump, Gilly was attempting the pull but decided to abort at the 11th over
upper cut away to the right of third-man for a single, it was shorter in length again and he cut it away, wanted a second but Gilly refuses
cut away to a ball outside the off stump, on the length, straight to the third-man fielder for a run
pitched up to the bat and he swings the bat, goes to mid-on on the bounce
shorter one, carrom ball, cut away but well fielded at point and six is all they get from the over
quicker on his pads and he misses it, hits the pads, some appeal but was going down
pitched right up to the bat and he goes to swing it over mid-wicket, missed it
quicker, good length, on his pads, flicked away to square-leg for a single
floated up, on the middle stump, driven to long-on for a single
reverse swept first ball, over backward point for four! It was on the middle and Mandeep spanks him straightaway!
pitched on the length and climbing outside the off stump, misses the outside edge of the bat, through to the keeper
outside the off stump, fuller, driven to the covers and goes to the point fielder
forced shot through the bowler's hands, pitched up to the bat and Gilchrist smacks it on the up, hits the bowler's hands and still runs away to the fence
pitched right up, on his pads, misses the bat, there was an in-swing on it and the appeal was immediately negated
quicker one, fuller, and he gives it his all, missed the outside edge, beaten. Gilly has a word with the youngster
outside the off stump, moving away, pushed to the off side to the covers
short of length, on the leg side, he manages to tap it away for a single
tries to pull it away, hits his pads and it runs down to the third-man for a single
fuller outside the off stump, driven to the mid-off fielder and despite a slip, he manages to recover in time to stall the single
outside the off the stump, pitched up and drilled through extra cover for a four!
slashed away for four by Mandeep, outside the off stump and the batsman went after it, was in the air through the first half of its journey but the diving point fielder did not get his hands to it
another one of the middle, deviates away slightly, pushed back in defence
edged though the non-existent third slip and that has gone for a four! There were two slips in place and it missed both of them...
outside the off stump and moving away yet again, quick ball, was sparring at it, misses the outside edge
pitched on middle and sharp swing away from the bat, beaten first ball, there were two slips in place there!
pitched right up to the bat, swing into the batsman, gets an inside edge to fine-leg
